$comment: QR-18: each crate's floor for line and region coverage of the native test run, as `cargo xtask coverage` measures it (one `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` run; every workspace test counts toward every crate). A floor starts at the first measured value rounded down and only goes up: a measurement under it fails, and so does a floor more than headroomPoints below it, so the PR that earned the coverage raises the floor (`cargo xtask coverage --update` only raises). Lowering a floor is a hand edit with its reason here.

bindings/native-fixture.reason: a minimal binary that exists so the hardening and reproducibility gates have a subject; it has no tests and nothing to cover

bindings/wasm.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 66.25% lines and 60.04% regions; the per-module test exports (edge_router, coincident_ends) are exercised by the wasm differentials, not natively. Raised to 74 lines and 68 regions when tests/survivors_budget_write_back.rs reached the budget write-back: 75.70% lines locally, 69.80% regions on CI. Raised to 82 lines and 77 regions with the OKF exports, replayed natively from okf.jsonl (tests/okf_oracle.rs) beside the exports' own tests: 82.97% lines and 77.43% regions locally. Raised to 87 lines and 82 regions with the JSON Canvas exports and their canvas wire, replayed from json-canvas.jsonl (tests/json_canvas_oracle.rs) beside the exports' and the wire's own tests: 87.99% lines and 82.47% regions, measured both locally and on CI (an earlier local reading of 89.57% and 84.13% was not reproduced, and set the floor above what the tests reach). Raised to 88 lines and 84 regions with the facet write export, replayed from facet-write.jsonl (tests/facet_write_oracle.rs) beside its own tests: 89.84% lines and 85.14% regions locally, measured over this crate's tests alone (the workspace run adds none to it)

core/canvas-render.reason: first measured 2026-11-11 at 99.45% lines and 98.41% regions, over the SVG backend ported from the TypeScript: the recorded svg.jsonl and svg-edge-cases.jsonl replayed natively (tests/svg_oracle.rs, tests/svg_edge_cases.rs) beside the TypeScript-derived expectations for the ink, arrowheads, flattener and bounds and the unit tests of the serializer, hoist and filter budget; what is left is arms no scene reaches (a node kind a caller never builds, a refusal the oracle cannot write because JSON holds no non-finite number)

Raised to 98 and 97 once the OKF envelope joined, replayed from okf.jsonl (tests/okf_oracle.rs) beside its examples and properties: 98.67% lines and 97.99% regions. The floor sits a point under. Raised to 99 and 98 with the length check and the refinement messages: 99.14% lines and 98.24% regions

core/det.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 98.81% lines and 98.68% regions. Raised to 99 and 99 with the number formatter's tie rule: 99.73% lines and 99.60% regions

core/edge-routing.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 94.47% lines and 94.57% regions, with the wasm crate's replay of the TypeScript's recorded answers (71.37% and 69.20% from the crate's own tests alone); raised with the native properties to 97.06-97.34% lines and 96.72-96.94% regions over four runs.
